name: Zhejiang Songyuan Automotive Safety Systems Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Songyuan Automotive Safety Systems Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, research, development, production, sale, and service of automotive parts and accessories in China and internationally. The company offers seat belt assemblies, air bags, steering wheels, other automotive passive safety system products, special seat safety devices, emergency locking seat belts, force-limiting seat belts, zero-gravity seat belts, and pretensioning motor seat belts. It also provides airbag controllers, collision sensors, door pressure sensors, steering wheel switches, controllers with integrated hands-off detection and electric heating.
